identitySignals: Name matches registered 501(c)(3) 'Kaiser Foundation Hospitals', EIN 94-1105628, Oakland, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer)

Eat. Learn. Play. Foundation page describes a $2.5 million Kaiser Permanente grant supporting OUSD's Central Kitchen, matching the agenda's grant agreement for the Central Kitchen, Educational Center and Instructional Farm
Kaiser Permanente's own news page says it has given multi-year grants to Oakland Unified totaling $60 million since 2010
research.notes: Agenda gives South San Francisco, CA (likely the Northern California regional office); the registered headquarters per IRS/ProPublica is Oakland. The funder is the Northern California Community Benefit Programs Division of Kaiser Foundation Hospitals. Contact details and CA entity number not verified, so left null.

profile.summary: Kaiser Foundation Hospitals is a nonprofit that is part of Kaiser Permanente, an integrated care and coverage organization that provides health care services and health plans. Its stated purpose is to provide high-quality, affordable health care and to improve the health of its members and the communities it serves.

sources.title: Kaiser Foundation Hospitals - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: ProPublica confirms Kaiser Foundation Hospitals as a 501(c)(3) with EIN 94-1105628 in Oakland, and the agenda's grantor is the Northern California region/Community Benefit division of that same entity. The Kaiser Permanente page supports the parent-organization description and mission; the website is the Kaiser Permanente parent site.
